newsitems.title: Palworld v0.6.8 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: Pocketpair
newsitems.contents:
Thank you for playing Palworld!
We have released v0.6.8.

[h2]Balance adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased the attack power of Jetragon by 10%
[*]Reduced stamina consumption while gliding from 20 to 15
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Pals could fall through the floor of the base
[*]Fixed a crash when opening the Paldeck on Xbox
[*]Multiplayer
[list]
[*]Fixed a desync when joining a guild base
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12345/abcdef.png[/img]
[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some players may experience stuttering on the [PC] version.
[/list]

newsitems.contents:

- Fixed incorrect item names in the Chinese localization
